newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Wiener St'sche 9-mth income up 22.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Wiener St'sche 9-mth income up 22.2 pct.

text.p: Austrian insurance company Wiener Staedtische Allgemeine Versicherung AG said on Monday premium income in the first nine months of the year rose 22.2 percent to 24.3 billion schillings.
The group said it expects full-year premium to reach 30 billion schillings as its life insurance business continues to boom.
In 1995, the group reported a premium income of around 27 billion schillings.
In the January to September period, life insurance premiums notched up a 65.9 percent gain to 10.7 billion schillings.

Premiums for damage and accident insurance managed a 1.8 percent increase on the year-ago period to 11 billion schillings despite fierce competition in the car insurance market, the group said in a statement.
Health insurance premiums were in line with company expectations, down 1.3 percent at 2.6 billion schillings. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 253
